recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內充滿大小不一、背靠背排列的濾泡，生發中心大而淡染，外圍有清楚的深藍色套層（mantle zone）包覆，濾泡間區也保存；這是反應性濾泡增生（follicular hyperplasia）的樣式，於 IgG4 相關淋巴結病變中常見，需配合 IgG4/IgG 染色。
features: Numerous enlarged secondary follicles of variable size and shape
Well-defined, intact dark mantle zones surrounding each follicle
Preserved interfollicular areas with small vessels
Mild interfollicular sclerosis/eosinophilic stroma, subtle at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows numerous enlarged secondary lymphoid follicles of varying size with large, pale germinal centers and well-defined, intact mantle zones. The interfollicular areas are preserved and contain small vessels, with only subtle stromal sclerosis at this magnification. There is no back-to-back crowding with loss of mantle zones or capsular breach in this field. The findings represent reactive follicular hyperplasia, which in the appropriate clinical and immunohistochemical context (increased IgG4+ plasma cells with high IgG4/IgG ratio) may reflect IgG4-related lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded monotonous follicles with attenuated mantles, lack of polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and BCL2-positive germinal centers.
These also show florid follicular hyperplasia with plasmacytosis, so separation depends on serology, capsular fibrosis with endarteritis (syphilis) and IgG4 counts.

ddx.dx: Castleman disease (hyaline vascular / plasma cell type)
ddx.vs: Castleman disease shows regressed germinal centers with onion-skin mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels or sheets of interfollicular plasma cells.
